snippet.title: Calling All Cars! PS3 (gameplay)
snippet.description:
I wanted to try this game really quick to see what it was about. As seen in the video, I think this could be a really fun one to play with friends.

Calling All Cars! is a downloadable video game developed by Incognito Entertainment and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for PlayStation 3. It was released in 2007.
